target.title: feat(scripts): serialize pr prepare gates and add remote Testbox test gate
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`scripts/pr` landing gates run the full `pnpm test` (88 vitest shards) locally in the `.worktrees/<pr>` checkout and require it green before `prepare-push`/`merge-run`. On a maintainer Mac that also runs VMs and other agent sessions this is effectively un-passable: shards stall >120s under load and the `scripts/run-vitest.mjs` no-output watchdog SIGTERMs them, and a concurrent `scripts/pr` gate run's children die on the shared heavy-check lock's 10-minute timeout while its unlocked `pnpm build` piles more load onto the holder's shards. Observed repeatedly landing PRs #99935/#100026 on 2026-07-04/05: zero real test failures, only watchdog kills and lock contention with a concurrent run for `.worktrees/pr-100046`. Root `AGENTS.md` validation policy already says full suites belong on Crabbox/Testbox, not the Mac.

Fixes #100226.

## Why This Change Was Made

- **`OPENCLAW_PR_GATES_REMOTE=testbox`** (opt-in; local stays the default): `prepare_gates` and the lease-retry gates run the same full-suite `pnpm test` on a Blacksmith Testbox through `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs run --provider blacksmith-testbox ...` — the exact delegation shape `pnpm check:changed` already uses (same workflow `.github/workflows/ci-check-testbox.yml`, job `check`). The worktree's own wrapper copy is used deliberately so the crabbox sync ships the prep tree, not the primary checkout. The `tbx_` lease id and Actions run URL from the crabbox `--timing-json` report (single-line JSON on stderr; verified against `../crabbox` `internal/cli/timing.go` and `internal/providers/blacksmith/backend.go`) are recorded in `.local/gates.env` as `REMOTE_GATES_PROVIDER` / `REMOTE_GATES_LEASE_ID` / `REMOTE_GATES_RUN_URL` with `GATES_MODE=remote_testbox`, and surface in `.local/prep.md` at `prepare-push`. `pnpm build`/`pnpm check` stay local. Unsupported values fail fast, and combining with `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1` (hosted exact-head evidence) is rejected as ambiguous.
- **Whole-block gate serialization**: `scripts/pr-gates-lock.mjs` holds the existing shared heavy-check lock (`toolName: "pr-gates"`, 2h default wait instead of the 10-minute per-command default) for the entire local gate block; gate stages inherit the same `OPENCLAW_TEST_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_HELD`/`OPENCLAW_TSGO_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_HELD`/`OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_LOCK` child contract `check:changed` already uses, so they don't re-acquire. Concurrent gate runs across `.worktrees` now queue as whole units before their first command instead of dying mid-test. The holder releases on SIGTERM, on gate-shell death (ppid watch), and stays covered by the lock runtime's owner-pid reclaim; in remote mode the lock is released before the remote test so the Mac stays usable.
- **Lease-retry stamp integrity** (autoreview finding, fixed): when a lease retry rebases the prep head and reruns gates, the retry path now rewrites `.local/gates.env` for the new head through the shared `write_gates_env_stamp` writer, and `prepare_push` re-sources it, so `prep.md`/`prep.env` never attribute stale gate evidence (mode, heads, or Testbox lease) to the pushed commit.

## User Impact

Maintainer tooling only (no product/runtime surface). `scripts/pr prepare-gates`/`prepare-run` become passable on loaded hosts via a sanctioned remote full-test gate with an auditable Testbox stamp, and concurrent landings no longer kill each other's gates. Default behavior on an idle host is unchanged.

## Evidence

- Behavior tests: `test/scripts/pr-prepare-gates.test.ts` (17 tests) — mode resolution + hosted-mode conflict, exact wrapper argv, stamp extraction (last successful report wins; failure-only logs rejected), lease-retry stamp refresh (remote + local), lock helper acquire/queue/SIGTERM-release/parent-death-release/timeout-failure, and the bash acquire/release env contract. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/pr-prepare-gates.test.ts` → 17 passed; sibling `pr-wrappers` + `verify-pr-hosted-gates` suites → 6 passed.
- Remote Testbox `check:changed` over this diff (lanes docs+tooling incl. `lint scripts`): exit 0, lease `tbx_01kwrne1rn5q9212yahvphf5k9`, 1m56s.
- Live busy-Mac verification (load average ~20, real open PR worktree `.worktrees/pr-100046`, `OPENCLAW_PR_GATES_REMOTE=testbox`): `pnpm build` and `pnpm check` passed locally while `owner.json` showed the gate lock held as `"tool": "pr-gates"`, the lock released before delegation, and the full suite ran on Blacksmith Testbox lease `tbx_01kwrp4esmb266qeh0nxfvjns4` — 89 shards in 776s, 3 shards genuinely red on that PR's stale prep tree (`unit-fast`, `extension-diffs`, `extension-acpx`), so the gate **failed closed**: exit 1, failure digest + rerun commands printed, crabbox failure bundle captured, and no `.local/gates.env` stamp written.
- Success-path stamp on live data: the parser extracts `tbx_01kwrne1rn5q9212yahvphf5k9` from the real successful crabbox timing report and extracts nothing from the real failed gate log; the stamp write itself is covered by the lease-retry tests. The ambient-env conflict guard also fired live (this session exports `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1`), refusing the remote mode until the harness cleared it.
- Not run: a green end-to-end remote gate (both candidate PR trees were red or mid-landing by another session) and a full local 88-shard default-mode run on a quiet host — the local test invocation is byte-identical to `main` apart from the lock wrap, which the live build/check run and the lock tests cover.

Autoreview (codex/gpt-5.5): first pass found the lease-retry stale-stamp issue (fixed above); rerun clean — "no accepted/actionable findings".
